data.name: Gridiron Remastered
data.detailed_description:
This is Gridiron Remastered.

Once destined to return, Gridiron is back! Rebuilt from the ground up and reborn in Unreal Engine 5 with stunning new visuals, smoother gameplay, and a renewed competitive spirit.

Gridiron is a fast-paced 7v7 American football experience where you control a single player in immersive third-person action. Precision passing, strategic routes, and real-time coordination with teammates are key to victory. Whether you're calling the shots as QB, locking down opponents on defense, or sprinting to the end zone, every play is yours.

Built for online teamplay and fueled by community feedback, Gridiron Remastered blends the intensity of traditional football with the speed and style of modern competitive games.

Features:

  • High-speed 5v5 & 7v7 gameplay – One-player control, full team coordination.

  • Custom matches – From quick 3v3 battles to full 7v7 football.

  • Immersive third-person action – Feel every snap, block, pass, and tackle.

  • Skill-based mechanics – Timing, aim, and teamwork matter.

  • Remastered in Unreal Engine 5 – Enhanced lighting, animations, and environments.

  • Built for multiplayer – Jump in solo or team up with friends.

It’s time to hit the field again.  Welcome to the new era of Gridiron!

data.short_description: Control one player in high-octane 7v7 american football action. Compete from an immersive third-person view and work with your squad to dominate the competition. Precision physics based passing, explosive runs, and strategic coordination. This is football reimagined for competitive online play.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 (64-bit) or newer
  • Processor: a 2.5GHz dual-core CPU
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DX11 Compatible GeForce GTX 460 1GB or AMD HD 6850 1GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DX11 compatible
